Product Features

  • HYDRAULIC LIFT – The tabletop can be lifted easily and smoothly, thanks to a hydraulic lifting system.
  • SLIDING FUNCTION – The right half of the tabletop can be pushed to the side, providing additional storage space and flexibility.
  • BUILT-IN STORAGE – There is plenty of storage space under both tabletops for books, magazines or remote controls to keep the living room tidy.
  • HIGH-GLOSS DESIGN – The front, sides and top panel are finished with an elegant high-gloss finish that gives a luxurious look.
  • LED LIGHTING – The table is equipped with LED lights that provide pleasant and modern lighting, ideal for atmospheric evenings.
  • IDEAL DIMENSIONS – At 100x50x45 cm, this tea table is compact yet offers plenty of space and functionality.
  • STYLISH VERSATILITY – Perfect for modern living rooms, this table offers a combination of elegance, functionality and storage.

Descriptions

This modern and versatile tea table is a highlight for any living room. With a size of 100x50x45 cm, it not only offers enough space, but also impresses with its elegant design. The tea table has an innovative function: one half of the tabletop can be lifted hydraulically, while the other half can be slid to the right. There is generous storage space under both tabletops, which is ideal for books, remote controls or other everyday items. The table has a noble high-gloss finish on the front, sides and top top, which provides a modern and luxurious look. In addition, the tea table has integrated LED lighting, which gives the room an atmospheric atmosphere, especially in the evening hours. The hydraulic lifting system ensures smooth and effortless adjustment of the table height, ideal for working, eating or relaxing on the couch. Thanks to the thoughtful combination of functionality and stylish design, this tea table is a perfect addition to modern living spaces. Its smart construction with storage space makes it not only practical, but also a real eye-catcher in your home.
